text_markup: If a static ability or a mandatory conditional ability interrupt would prevent the steps of paying a cost from being carried out if they were performed as an effect, that cost cannot be paid.
text_plain: If a static ability or a mandatory conditional ability interrupt would prevent the steps of paying a cost from being carried out if they were performed as an effect, that cost cannot be paid.

examples.text_markup: The Runner cannot pay the additional cost to steal {card:Obokata Protocol} while {card:Guru Davinder} is installed, because the Runner could not currently take 4 damage if instructed to: {card:Guru Davinder}'s first ability would prevent the damage.
examples.text_plain: The Runner cannot pay the additional cost to steal Obokata Protocol while Guru Davinder is installed, because the Runner could not currently take 4 damage if instructed to: Guru Davinder's first ability would prevent the damage.

examples.text_markup: The Runner is playing as {card:Jesminder Sareen} and encounters {card:Funhouse}, without any other tag-related effects resolving earlier in the run. Since {card:Jesminder Sareen}'s ability would prevent taking 1 tag, the Runner cannot take 1 tag to pay the nested cost in {card:Funhouse}'s ability. {card:Funhouse} will end the run.
examples.text_plain: The Runner is playing as Jesminder Sareen and encounters Funhouse, without any other tag-related effects resolving earlier in the run. Since Jesminder Sareen's ability would prevent taking 1 tag, the Runner cannot take 1 tag to pay the nested cost in Funhouse's ability. Funhouse will end the run.
